summary: HelmCharts aa875f7 on phase/018-P5: production Grafana offers Keycloak generic OAuth (homelab realm, root_url http://grafana.home/) gated by the grafana client's admin role via the access token, mapped to Grafana Admin under role_attribute_strict; client id/secret come from eso/prd/grafana/prd/oidc through a new manifests.yaml ExternalSecret as GF_AUTH_GENERIC_OAUTH_* env overrides; dev release untouched. New test green, witnessed end to end on a local Grafana 12.3.1 against a fake Keycloak; kc project test green.
